$schemaNote: Machine-readable twin of docs/TEST_MAP.md. Area ids here MUST match the section ids in TEST_MAP.md — scripts/impact.mjs and scripts/impact.test.mjs enforce this. Glob syntax: '**' matches any number of path segments (including zero), '*' matches within one segment. A path may legitimately appear under more than one area (shared fan-out: RequestForm.tsx, WeekGrid.tsx, src/solver/**, i18n files) — that is intentional, not a bug.

areas.title: Scheduled car maintenance
qaChecklist: As the car's responsible member, open the car page: 'טיפול הבא' line, 'תקופת טיפול' button; set a period over several days (REQ §13.114)

On the siddur and the board the period is a hatched band in the car's column, no extra icon; the responsible member / Sadran / admin can drag it, resize its top and bottom, or click it; another member sees it read-only
Extend a period over a booked ride: the ride is flagged, its driver and the Sadran are notified; shorten it back and the flag clears
Admin issues screen: 'העבר לטיפול' on an unsafe issue asks only for the end (start = now); the cars list shows 'טיפול הבא'
Request a ride on a car inside a period (live week): another car is chosen or the request is waitlisted — never placed inside the period
